purpose: Exact-source cut for the fast terminal lane encoder and its canonical digest encoder dependency.
adaptations: The fixed POOL_V1_PAIR_EMPTY_ROOTS constant is an explicit function argument, as in the previously accepted lane-write cut.
ProgramError is represented by the local StateHistoryMismatch-only carrier.

The production nested mutable slice alias `tree = &mut output[80..]` is represented through equivalent direct output offsets (the lane header is 80 bytes). Both production loops over the 20 frontier levels are expanded to literal indexed cases because Aeneas 4.32 cannot interpret the loop body with mutable output plus early return: the check at level k is exactly `(next_leaf_index >> k) & 1 == 0 && frontier[k] != empty_roots[k]`; the output write at level k is `frontier[k]` to `output[128+32*k..160+32*k]`, for k=0..19. The digest byte encoder's loop is likewise expanded to eight literal 4-byte pairs because Aeneas raised Unexpected return while interpreting the nested loop. These are reversible loop-unroll translations; the production loops and copy statements are pinned above.
Only the declarations needed by the copied encoder body are retained; their literal values are pinned below.

correspondence: The output initialization and literal header writes are copied from production lines 480-488.
Production's mutable tree subslice at line 489 is replaced by full-output offsets adding the fixed 80-byte header length.
Tree metadata and index writes at lines 490-496 are retained at the corresponding full-output offsets.
The production frontier iterator at lines 497-500 is expanded to twenty writes at offsets 128 + 32*k through 160 + 32*k, k=0..19.
The output-construction tail returns the array directly; production wraps that same array in Ok after this tail.
The exact production encode_digest_canonical and M31::to_le_bytes bodies are retained from the pinned declarations above; the digest's eight fixed copies are expanded in the cut.
